source_candidate_breakdown.definition: Street+ZIP groups absent from ALL existing location rows, including excluded rows. Suites do not define these groups; inspect source_refs.records for additional offices at represented buildings. No group is a confirmed missing office.

state_definitions.CONFIRMED_OPERATING_GP: Ledger decision: operating GP (or mixed GP) office confirmed at this address within the validity window.
state_definitions.NEEDS_CURRENT_VERIFICATION: Likely an office; no contradiction in existing data, but no current confirmation.
state_definitions.EXISTING_EVIDENCE_NO_CURRENT_CONTRADICTI: Existing directory row with no detected material contradiction. Deferred, not confirmed; evidence availability varies.
state_definitions.IDENTITY_REVIEW: Row may merge several offices (multi-tenant building) or duplicate another row; settle identity first.
state_definitions.OPERATING_STATUS_UNRESOLVED: Existing data contradicts current operation (closure/move note, dead site, no contact channel).
state_definitions.GP_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED: Unclear whether general dentistry is offered here (specialist signals on a directory row, or GP signals on an excluded specialist row).
state_definitions.LOCATION_INCOMPLETE: Address unusable for a physical office (PO box, no street number, state mismatch).
state_definitions.PROBABLE_NON_OFFICE: Excluded row or raw record that is probably not a patient-facing GP office; confirm exclusion.
state_definitions.LIKELY_SPECIALIST_ONLY: Excluded specialist row with no GP signal; low-priority exclusion check.
state_definitions.SOURCE_CANDIDATE_UNREPRESENTED: Raw source record (Data Axle / NPPES / DSO locator) at a street address the office table does not have.
state_definitions.EXTERNAL_DISCOVERY: Office added from outside the repo's data by a research session; awaiting a decision.
state_definitions.RESEARCHED_UNRESOLVED: Researched; evidence insufficient either way. Needs a call or manual review.
state_definitions.RESOLVED_EXCLUDED: Ledger decision: not a current GP office (closed, moved, duplicate, specialist-only, non-clinical).
state_definitions.RESOLVED_SPLIT: Ledger decision: record merged several offices; child candidates carry them.
